title: Trump admin fights ABC lawsuit as watchdogs worry Disney will settle with FCC
summary: FCC tells court it is “open-minded" about whether ABC should lose licenses.
llm_summary: The Trump administration is pushing back against a lawsuit filed by ABC, while consumer‑watchdog groups fear that Disney might simply settle the dispute with the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) to keep its broadcast licenses. The FCC told the court it remains “open‑minded” about the possibility that ABC could lose those licenses,
